response.sql: WITH city_stats AS (SELECT a.city_id, COUNT(*) as address_count FROM address a GROUP BY a.city_id) SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count / (SUM(address_count) OVER () / COUNT(*) OVER ()) as relative_to_avg, address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () as share FROM city_stats ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
